why: The standing display moved from the tokens to the bounty, the party's shared purse, so exactly one datum asks to stand and it is `party`-scoped. A party datum's value lives on the `#party` holder, and the sidebar hides every holder whose name starts with `#`, so what the slot would draw is a heading over nothing. Refused with the scope named as the cause; the remedy is a `player` scope or no `display`, never a mirror onto a name a real player could carry. It declares no unit: `display` is bound by the primary; what must not compile is a display the pinned game cannot draw.
